professional_summary: Full-Stack and Generative AI developer pursuing a B.Tech in Electronics & Communication Engineering (2027 batch). Builds and deploys MERN applications using React, Redux Toolkit, Node.js, Express.js and MongoDB, with experience in REST API design, layered controller-service-model architecture, JWT authentication, role-based access control, Razorpay payments and webhooks, Socket.IO real-time communication, media handling and geospatial search. Also develops Python-based Generative AI systems, including RAG applications with vector databases, multilingual video knowledge retrieval, and stateful LangGraph agents.

engineering_strengths.details: Developing end-to-end web applications with React, Redux Toolkit, Node.js, Express.js and MongoDB.
Building modular REST APIs with controller-service-model separation, reusable services and structured data models.
Implementing JWT-based authentication with HTTP-only cookies, refresh tokens, email OTP and backend-enforced RBAC.
Integrating Razorpay with server-side amount calculation, signature verification, webhook processing and protected refund workflows.
Using Socket.IO rooms and events for live notifications, booking updates, likes and comments.
Using MongoDB geospatial queries, including $geoNear, with Leaflet and OpenStreetMap maps.
Creating document and media ingestion pipelines, generating dense embeddings, indexing them in vector databases and retrieving semantically relevant context.
Designing stateful multi-step LangGraph workflows with structured state, tool calling, inventory validation and controlled transitions.

projects.name: Near It...
projects.overview: A three-role service marketplace connecting customers with local service providers, with booking coordination, provider verification, geospatial discovery and online payments.
projects.architecture: React + Redux Toolkit frontend → Express REST API (/api/v1) and Socket.IO → MongoDB and Mongoose → Razorpay and Leaflet
highlights: Built a three-role marketplace for customers, providers and administrators.
Architected 90+ REST APIs and 15 MongoDB models using controller-service-model separation.
Implemented a five-stage booking lifecycle: PENDING, ACCEPTED, ON_THE_WAY, STARTED and COMPLETED.
Implemented JWT authentication using HTTP-only cookies and refresh tokens.
Added email OTP verification with a three-minute expiry and backend-enforced RBAC.
Integrated Razorpay with server-side amount calculation, payment signature verification and four webhook events.
Implemented an admin refund flow with duplicate-request protection.
Added nearby-provider discovery using MongoDB $geoNear within a 1–200 km radius.
Integrated Leaflet and OpenStreetMap maps.
Used Socket.IO rooms for real-time notifications, provider location updates and booking status alerts.

projects.name: YouTube Video AI Knowledge Assistant
projects.tagline: Ask questions about YouTube videos and playlists with timestamp-based answers
projects.overview: A multilingual YouTube RAG application that processes videos and playlists, transcribes audio, indexes transcript embeddings in Qdrant and answers questions with clickable timestamp citations.
projects.architecture: React + Vite frontend → FastAPI backend → Faster-Whisper and yt-dlp → Qdrant vector database → Groq / LLM APIs
highlights: Supports questions in English, Hindi and Hinglish.
Uses yt-dlp for video and audio extraction.
Uses Faster-Whisper for audio transcription.
Generates embeddings and performs semantic similarity search using Qdrant.
Provides clickable timestamp citations that take users to relevant video moments.
Includes a split-screen chat interface with a synchronized transcript excerpt viewer.

projects.name: Restaurant Assistant Agent
projects.overview: A stateful conversational ordering agent that extracts food items and quantities, validates inventory, handles unavailable items and simulates the cooking and serving lifecycle.
projects.architecture: User input → LangGraph StateGraph → Extraction node → Inventory-check tool → Order state machine → Kitchen simulation
highlights: Models a multi-step order workflow using LangGraph StateGraph.
Extracts food items, quantities and customer preferences from natural-language requests.
Checks restaurant inventory and handles partially available or out-of-stock items.
Simulates preparation, cooking and serving status transitions.
Uses structured output parsing and deterministic state management.

projects.name: LLM Resume Screening & Embeddings
projects.tagline: Structured resume parsing, candidate scoring and semantic embedding generation
projects.overview: A modular Python LLM application with resume screening, PDF/DOCX parsing, structured candidate evaluation and 384-dimensional embeddings as a foundation for semantic retrieval.
highlights: Developed an 11-module Python application using the Groq API.
Parses PDF and DOCX resumes and job descriptions.
Uses Groq and Pydantic to produce structured JSON outputs.
Scores candidates based on technical skills, experience and education.
Generates 384-dimensional embeddings using all-MiniLM-L6-v2.
Explores generation settings including temperature and max_tokens.
Tracks token usage and handles API errors.
Uses uv for isolated Python dependency and environment management.
Loads API keys securely through environment variables.

projects.name: Pluto
projects.overview: A full-featured MERN social network with real-time interactions, media uploads, a vertical short-video feed and social engagement features.
projects.architecture: React + Redux Toolkit → Express REST API and Socket.IO → MongoDB and Mongoose → Cloudinary
highlights: Built 60+ REST APIs and 19 MongoDB models.
Implemented JWT authentication and profile management.
Integrated Cloudinary uploads with automatic cleanup of replaced images.
Created a Reels/Shorts-style vertical video feed with IntersectionObserver autoplay and infinite scrolling.
Implemented TTL-based video view tracking with 15-day expiry.
Added likes, nested comments, follow/unfollow, saved posts and watch history.
Implemented real-time like and comment synchronization using Socket.IO rooms and 25+ events.
Used optimistic UI updates for responsive interactions.
Organized asynchronous frontend state using 11 Redux Toolkit slices and thunks.

portfolio_metrics.note: The two live platforms are Near It... and Pluto. The three AI projects are presented as AI repositories in the portfolio.
